key_findings: Among 212 Japanese FEPS patients, 30.2% carried pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants of SCN11A (19.8%), SCN10A (6.6%) or SCN9A (3.8%); SCN11A p.R222H accounted for 11.8%.
SCN11A-FEPS had earlier pain onset than SCN10A or SCN9A groups; provisional clinical diagnostic criteria proposed.
